evidence_integrity.acquisition_commit_difference: Baseline was collected at3b655bad; training/evaluation at4f2ce5f. Scientific source Git blobs, byte hashes, protocol and all other provenance fields match. Both commits are preserved.
evidence_integrity.checkpoint_selection: Fixed final8192-step checkpoint per declared seed; no held-out selection.
evidence_integrity.primitive_identity_policy: Compare physical state, node metrics, simulation duration, resets and outcomes exactly, excluding only nested elapsed_wall_time_s metadata. Original metadata-inclusive comparison is retained separately.

interpretation.active_window: Twelve walk/turn target skills out of16 transitions per baseline complete after2s. Learned residual cannot actuate after2s, although PPO receives masked decisions and completion reward later. Stop completes inside the window. Recovery measures an early0.2s interval of nominal-command tracking, not target completion or persistent tracking through the full skill.
interpretation.binary_ceiling: Both baselines already pass all16 held-out transitions; deterministic correction passes all26 cases. No learned fail-to-pass opportunity exists on this sample.
interpretation.delta_convention: Candidate minus deterministic correction. Node error/drift deltas use absolute magnitudes. Raw transition heading change includes intended rotation and is not an error.
interpretation.dominant_gap_qualified: The most supported structural gap is transition/reference semantics: node-local feedback and late completion outside the actuation window. Reward alignment is a contributor. Capacity, absent observations and insufficient budget were not isolated and cannot be diagnosed from this pilot.
interpretation.generalization_scope: Nominal deterministic MuJoCo parameter-combination holdout with two PPO training seeds. This is not disturbance/dynamics robustness or Phase2.3 Final Runtime evidence.
interpretation.observed_seed_tradeoffs: Seed11 improves stop time and early recovery with mixed geometric errors. Seed29 delays stop and increases window-end speed while some heading errors decrease. Walking entry durations are shorter and speed RMS is higher in both seeds; the effects are not predominantly explained by slowing all walking.
interpretation.primitive_compatibility: All8 primitive cases per seed are physically identical to deterministic correction because residual is masked zero. This supports integration compatibility, not learned primitive competence gains.
interpretation.reference_frame: Every node uses actual node-start heading/origin for local errors and walking correction; ideal commanded path persists separately. Stand10 creates -5.367deg before the first walk in sequence16m. This offset is inherited by local walk axes. Deterministic local walk maximum heading error0.228deg coexists with final ideal heading -6.348deg and lateral error -1.840m.
interpretation.reward_alignment: Dense and terminal costs use local heading/lateral errors; ideal path is observed but not penalized. Local metric gains need not improve commanded path. This is a plausible contributor, not an isolated causal result.
interpretation.sequence_negative_result: All local task and physical gates pass. Both models worsen sequence16m final ideal heading; seed29 also worsens lateral error substantially. Sequence12m has mixed tradeoffs. No global route PASS/FAIL threshold was added.
interpretation.slowing_reward_hack: No broad evidence of walking slowdown as a reward hack. Per-case speed/time proxies are preserved. Translational speed RMS and total angular speed RMS are not generic quality objectives. This does not rule out every form of reward exploitation.
interpretation.statistical_scope: Descriptive fixed cases and training seeds only; no iid population inference, confidence interval or significance claim.

evaluate: Seed-separated local task and physical regressions
Final and maximum ideal commanded-path lateral/heading errors
Transition tracking and full completion time
hold_fixed: Base policy weights and controller gains
recommended_next_experiment.reason: Tests whether continuing deterministic feedback holds an inherited actual heading instead of the commanded route. It addresses an observed constraint at all walk times. Reward-only changes cannot remove continuing wrong-reference feedback after2s.
recommended_next_experiment.study_policy: A new independently frozen experiment only. Preserve this pilot and all old language evidence. Do not change current code or adopt a controller on the basis of this attribution.
